tagline: Conditioning first. Lean and capable, not bulked.
description: Weight stays deliberately low; volume and variety do the work. Flexibility, mobility, strength-endurance and agility over size or a one-rep max.

tagline: Size and symmetry. Working sets close to failure.
description: Moderate-to-heavy weight at moderate-to-high volume, taken near failure. Isolation work counts as much as the compounds, and each muscle group gets several exercises a session.

tagline: Maximal strength. Heavy, low reps, long rests.
description: Built around the squat, bench and deadlift and their close variants. Size is a side effect, not the target; accessories exist only to support the main lifts.
